summary: Ambipar Emergency Response filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of Ricardo Chagas from his positions as CEO and CFO. The board promptly appointed Dennys Spencer as interim CEO and CFO, effective immediately. This constitutes an abrupt leadership transition at the top, triggering the Management Changes category. No deal terms, pricing, or M&A activity were disclosed; the filing solely concerns governance. The swift interim appointment suggests continuity but raises questions about strategic direction. Watch for further executive appointments or potential strategic shifts as the company stabilizes leadership.
